dish.title: Argentine Grilled Strip Steak with Chimichurri, Grilled Potatoes, and Ensalada Criolla

recipe_version.title: Argentine Grilled Strip Steak with Chimichurri, Grilled Potatoes, and Ensalada Criolla
recipe_version.description: Thick strip steaks seasoned simply with coarse salt and grilled over high heat, sliced and spooned with sharp chimichurri of parsley, oregano, garlic, red wine vinegar, chile, and olive oil. Served with par-boiled grilled potatoes and a tomato and onion salad.

ingredients.name: New York strip steaks
ingredients.display_name: New York strip steaks, about 1 1/4 inches thick

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.note: 1/2 cup chimichurri, 2 tbsp potatoes, 2 tbsp salad

steps.title: Make the chimichurri
steps.body: Stir the parsley, oregano, garlic, 1/4 cup vinegar, chile flakes, 1/2 cup olive oil, and 1/2 tsp kosher salt together and set aside. Season the steaks with 1 1/2 tsp coarse salt and leave them at room temperature. Halve the potatoes; cut the tomatoes and slice the onion and pepper.

steps.title: Par-boil the potatoes
steps.body: Put the potatoes in a 4-quart pot with 8 cups water and 1 tbsp kosher salt, bring to a boil over high heat, about 10 minutes, and cook until just tender, about 12 minutes. Drain, steam dry 2 minutes, and toss with 2 tbsp olive oil.

steps.title: Dress the salad
steps.body: While the potatoes cook, toss the tomatoes, onion, and pepper with the remaining vinegar, 2 tbsp olive oil, and 1/2 tsp coarse salt (overlap stated).

steps.title: Preheat the grill
steps.body: Preheat the grill on high, lid closed, for 10 minutes, then clean and oil the grate.

steps.title: Grill
steps.body: Grill the potatoes cut side down until marked and crisp, about 6 minutes, turning once. At the same time, grill the steaks until 130 F for medium-rare, about 5 minutes per side. Rest the steaks 5 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Slice the steaks against the grain, spoon over plenty of chimichurri, and serve with the potatoes and ensalada criolla.

coverage_contribution: First Argentine meal. Chimichurri is a new sauce for the catalog. A strip-steak grill plate distinct from the existing flank and au-poivre steaks.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with steak-au-poivre-smashed-potatoes: grilled, a raw herb-vinegar sauce, no cream or pepper crust, grilled not smashed potatoes. Compared with gochujang-grilled-flank-steak: salt-only strip steak with chimichurri, no gochujang. Compared with grilled-lamb-chops-mint-salsa-verde in this wave: beef with parsley-oregano chimichurri, not lamb with mint salsa verde.
not_duplicate_of: Not a full asado with chorizo and morcilla (too many cuts for a weeknight).
